title: Modular Pretraining Enables Access Control (GRAM)
blurb: GRAM adds gradient-routed auxiliary MLPs to a base model so capabilities can be isolated and selectively disabled. Reproduced the 26M-param Simple Stories experiment on Modal A10G; compute-ratio evaluation follows the paper's Appendix-M power-law inversion.
